skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic financial services of commercial banks, including deposit services, credit services, and fee-based services.
Analyze financial reports of banks and financial companies, and understand the items of balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
Understand various types of deposits, deposit pricing, deposit insurance, and manage deposits through interest rates and terms.
Understand credit services, including credit forms, loan interest rate determination, and bank credit processes.
Understand fee-based services such as payment services, foreign exchange trading, agency services, investment advisory services, and treasury management.
Discuss and debate recent topics in banking business to understand industry practices and regulations.
Work in groups to select a topic in the field of banking and finance, prepare a research paper, present, and critique.
Apply critical thinking skills to understand and analyze banking operations and services.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and presentations.
Conduct research and prepare reports on banking and finance topics.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
Collaborate effectively with peers in group activities and presentations.
